liebermann.description_de: Roger Twysden, Ausgabe für Wheloc's Archaionomia (1644)
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Roger Twysden, in Wheloc’s edition of Lambarde’s Archaionomia (Cambridge, 1644)
liebermann.notes: Roger Twysden's edition in Wheloc's Archaionomia (1644) used for Hn, CHn cor and Hn Lond a text of the Lond class, Co and Or–Gi family. What Schmid prints as Tw for Wl art retr comes not from Wheloc but from Wilkins, who admits mixing Wl art and Wl art retr, so perhaps no separate manuscript lies behind it.
